pages.title: Summon Random Animal
pages.text: In this type of ritual, a $(#ad03fc)Spirit$() is summoned $(bold)as an untamed creature$() to take the shape of a random animal.$(br)Different rituals can be performed, each with their own respective animals, check in the ritual dummy or in the recipe output the $()

pages.title: Summon Random Animal
pages.text: possibilities.$(br2)The animal can be interacted with as its natural counterpart, including taming, breeding and loot.$(br)
